t: What Does The Name Qiaozhi Mean?
s: Qiaozhi (乔治/喬治, pinyin: Qiáozhì) is the standard Chinese transliteration of the name George, used across Mandarin-speaking contexts to render the Greek–Latin–English anthroponym Γεώργιος/Georgius/George into Sinographic form.
